title: Migration marker
description: Shared-local marker cst migrate writes at <common Git dir>/causet/migration.json (src/migration.js; ADR-0039 §3). Its presence means the repository uses the current names; `refs` records the object each former ref held when it was migrated, so a former ref that advanced afterwards is reported as legacy-ref-advanced rather than guessed at.

migratedAt.description: When the repository was first migrated.

updatedAt.description: When cst migrate last ran, for example to fast-forward an advanced ref.

refs.description: Former ref name to the object ID it held when it was last migrated; every value is an object ID.
